source_title: Jeb Cox Hired as Quarterra's Managing Director of Development in Texas - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Multifamily veteran to steer new development across the Lone Star State
CHARLOTTE, N.C. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Quarterra , an industry-leading multifamily development and investment management firm, today announced Jeb Cox as Managing Director of Development, Texas.
In his new role, Cox will oversee new multifamily development initiatives across the state. He will lead a divisional team through the full development project life cycle, including: land sourcing, entitlements, capitalization, design and construction execution, optimizing marketability and operability, lease-up and disposition.
"The foundation of Jeb's career is multifamily development and acquisitions, and he brings a seasoned and well-rounded approach to our Texas division," said Chris Cassidy, Quarterra Executive Managing Director of Development for the Eastern U.S. "We look forward to expanding and honing our market scope under Jeb's direction, and we're bullish about our pipeline opportunities."
Cox has nearly 20 years of experience leading the development of institutional-quality multifamily communities. Prior to joining Quarterra, Cox spent more than a decade at Mill Creek Residential. He previously served at Trammell Crow Residential and Creekstone Partners.
In total, Cox has been involved with the development and acquisition of nearly 14,000 apartment homes during his career, representing more than $2.1 billion in capitalization across all multifamily property types. His career has been dedicated to leading high-performing, collaborative teams and aligning strategic real estate solutions and drive growth â a focus he carries into his new post at Quarterra.
"Quarterra is one of those companies that truly understands the ever-evolving multifamily marketplace and tailors its development model to meet the demands of municipalities, renters, partners and investors alike," Cox said. "It's an honor to join an innovative industry leader like Quarterra, and I'm eager to get to work with this exemplary team to execute our development vision in Texas."
About Quarterra Quarterra is a real estate investment firm focused on creating long-term value through the development of high-quality multifamily communities nationwide. With 12 regional offices across 20 states, Quarterra combines institutional scale with local market expertise to deliver purposefully designed rental communities in high-growth markets. For more information, visit www.Quarterra.com.
